# 1.0.13

- Installed iPhone apps can continue automatic Microsoft startup recovery after a touch or key press that has not started an action, a tap on static content, or navigation between Events and Settings.
- Editing input and other control clicks still stop automatic navigation. Foreground, network, account checks, and recovery loop prevention are unchanged.

No migration or reinstallation is required. Microsoft may still require explicit reconnection if its session is unavailable.
